(()=>{document.querySelector('.arch-inspector,.studio-right-rail,.building-inspector,.measure-inspector').scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return 'scrolled the workspace so the right-hand menu is on screen'})()

(()=>{const a=document.querySelector('.live-assistant').getBoundingClientRect();const railEl=[...document.querySelectorAll('.arch-inspector,.studio-right-rail,.building-inspector,.measure-inspector')].find(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0);const rail=railEl.getBoundingClientRect();const launcher=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher');const out={railClass:railEl.className,panel:{l:Math.round(a.left),t:Math.round(a.top),w:Math.round(a.width),h:Math.round(a.height)},rail:{l:Math.round(rail.left),t:Math.round(rail.top),w:Math.round(rail.width),h:Math.round(rail.height)},launcherHidden:getComputedStyle(launcher).display==='none',railHidden:getComputedStyle(railEl).visibility==='hidden',pressed:document.querySelector('.rail-assistant-toggle')?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'),composerVisible:!!document.querySelector('#live-assistant-prompt')&&document.querySelector('#live-assistant-prompt').getBoundingClientRect().bottom<=innerHeight};const visTop=Math.max(rail.top,0),visBottom=Math.min(rail.bottom,innerHeight);out.visible={t:Math.round(visTop),h:Math.round(visBottom-visTop)};if(a.left>rail.left+4||Math.abs(a.top-visTop)>4||Math.abs(a.height-(visBottom-visTop))>4||Math.abs(a.right-innerWidth)>2||a.width<320)throw Error('Docked panel does not cover the visible rail: '+JSON.stringify(out));if(!out.launcherHidden||!out.railHidden||!out.composerVisible)throw Error('Rail mode state wrong: '+JSON.stringify(out));return out})()

(()=>{const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(document.querySelector('.architect-workspace').dataset.designId)));const wallIds=new Set(d.walls.map(w=>w.id));const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('.architect-plan [data-entity-id]')].find(e=>wallIds.has(e.getAttribute('data-entity-id'))&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>20);if(!el)throw Error('No wall primitive on the plan');const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();window.__refId=el.getAttribute('data-entity-id');el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.left+r.width/2,clientY:r.top+r.height/2,button:2}));return window.__refId})()

(()=>{const m=document.querySelector('.canvas-context-menu');const items=[...m.querySelectorAll('.canvas-context-item')].map(b=>b.dataset.item+':'+b.textContent.trim()+(b.disabled?' (disabled)':''));const small=[...m.querySelectorAll('.canvas-context-item')].filter(b=>b.getBoundingClientRect().height<44).length;const r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.right>innerWidth||r.bottom>innerHeight||r.left<0||r.top<0)throw Error('Menu outside viewport');if(small)throw Error(small+' menu items under 44 px');if(!items.some(i=>i.startsWith('reference:')))throw Error('No reference item');return {target:m.dataset.target,items,focused:document.activeElement?.className}})()

Change nothing else. Then tell me the wall's new length in mm.");ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return ta.value.slice(0,400)})()

(()=>{const tools=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-tool')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim().slice(0,220));const receipt=tools.find(t=>t.startsWith('edit_architect_elements')&&/Tool result/.test(t));const errors=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-error')].map(e=>e.textContent);const reply=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-assistant')].at(-1)?.textContent.slice(0,600);const w=document.querySelector('.architect-workspace');const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(w.dataset.designId)));const wall=d.walls.find(x=>x.id===window.__refId);if(!wall)throw Error('Referenced wall missing after edit');const len=Math.hypot(wall.b[0]-wall.a[0],wall.b[1]-wall.a[1]);window.__wallLen=len;if(!receipt)throw Error('No edit_architect_elements receipt. errors='+errors.join('|')+' tools='+tools.join('|'));const full=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-tool')].map(e=>e.textContent).find(t=>t.startsWith('edit_architect_elements')&&/Tool result/.test(t));if(!full.includes(window.__refId))throw Error('Edit receipt does not name the referenced wall id');return {refId:window.__refId,newLength:Math.round(len),revision:d.revision,reply,errors}})()
